_note: The DECLARED BLIND ZONE of every directory walk in tools/gates, and the only thing that may
be invisible to a hard light. JSON takes no comments, so this is where this file is explained.
WHY IT EXISTS. Four doors can hide a path from a gate: .gitignore, ignorePatterns in
.oxlintrc.jsonc, exclude in a tsconfig, and exclude in vitest.config.ts. 'I narrowed an include
and everything went green' is a real way to pass, so L-visible counts what is hidden under
packages/, apps/ and e2e/ NUMERICALLY against git ls-files and refuses anything this file does
not declare. walk() in tools/gates/lights/_shared.mjs skips a path for exactly one declared
reason: an entry here. The predicate (isExcluded) lives in the same module that reads this
file, so the blind zone and the light guarding it read ONE file through ONE reader.
ENTRIES IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS A STATEMENT, NOT A GAP. As of 2026-11-01 nothing under
packages/, apps/ or e2e/ is hidden from a walk: no tsconfig in this repository has an
'exclude' key, vitest.config.ts has none, and .oxlintrc.jsonc:60-68 hides only node_modules,
dist, coverage, playwright-report, test-results, .ci and .vitest — none of which exists under
those three roots today. So the honest list is empty. The day a build output appears (an
apps/web/dist, say) L-visible will refuse it until it is declared here, and that refusal is
the designed behaviour, not a false alarm: a declared blind spot is auditable, an undeclared
one is how a subtree stops being checked without anyone noticing.
WHAT NEVER NEEDS AN ENTRY. A '.'-prefixed segment (.git, .ci, .vitest, .pnpm) and
node_modules are already invisible to every tool in this toolchain, so declaring one would
change nothing; isExcluded reports them as self-hidden and L-visible does not count them.
That list is a frozen constant in CODE (SELF_HIDDEN in lights/_shared.mjs) and deliberately
not a field here: a configurable self-hidden list would be a second door, and the whole point
of this file is that there is one. Measured, and the reason it matters: apps/web/node_modules
is under apps/ and is hidden by .gitignore:2.
ENTRY SHAPE, checked by manifestProblems() in lights/_shared.mjs:
{ "path": "<repo-relative literal path>",
"doors": ["gitignore" | "oxlint-ignorePatterns" | "tsconfig-exclude" | "vitest-exclude"],
"why": "<one sentence>" }
A path matches an entry when it equals it or lies under it. NO GLOBS: a glob here would be a
small language nobody can audit, and 'which files does this hide' would stop being answerable
by reading. Naming the doors is what lets L-visible compare the declaration with what it
finds, so an entry that claims one door while a second also hides the path is a fail.
